sections.appearance: Yukari has extremely long silky purple hair that reaches well past her feet, and tied by a band at around her knees. She has purple eyes, and blushy cheeks. She has a cute little fang on her right side. Halo ==== Yukari's halo resembles a purple circle with a circular hollowed-out section. Uniform ==== Yukari wears a common Japanese sailor style school uniform that consists of a white dress shirt with a red sailor ribbon around her neck and a breastplate. She wears a navy blue colored skirt, knee-high socks and a traditional Japanese geta. She has a really baggy and long sky blue haori with white flower patterns that reaches the ground. For her accessories, she has several cherry blossom flowers on the right side of her hair. For her middle school uniform, Yukari wears a black short-sleeved sailor style shirt with a large black sailor collar that has a single white stripe along the edge, finished with a muted purple ribbon around her neck. She wears a black pleated skirt, plain white knee-high socks, and traditional black geta sandals with white straps. sections.personality: The multi-talented member of the well-known Kadenokouji family, Yukari strives to aid others since a young age. However, she mostly felt obligated to help others at that time under the expectations of the people around her. After a fateful encounter with Goryou Nagusa, she decided to join Hyakkaryouran to help as much people as she can under her own volition. She may not be as skilled as her upperclassmen, but she strives to improve everyday. Her sheltered upbringing has left her unaware of many common aspects of student life in Kivotos, such as convenience store food and video games. However, she has adapted quickly and greatly enjoys exploring her newfound independence.
